npcs.name: Marguerite "Mags" Pell
npcs.role: Owner of the Kettle & Crumb café; Canal Row's unofficial news service.

npcs.name: Osric Vane
npcs.role: Clerk of the Lanternside Civic Office; keeper of keys, forms and grudges.

npcs.name: Tibbs Hollow
npcs.role: Mechanic at Hollow Fixings on the Quay; inventor of things that should not exist.

npcs.name: Sir Richard E. Moneybucks, Esq.
npcs.role: Founder and owner of Ober's Oil. A genuinely ruthless robber baron — and a man you can do business with.

npcs.name: Bartholomew Crisp
npcs.role: Butler of Moneybucks Manor for thirty years. Decides who gets through the front door.

npcs.name: Agnes Thornbury
npcs.role: Secretary and bookkeeper to Sir Moneybucks. Sells Ober's Oil shares — and knows exactly what the books hide.

npcs.name: Gideon Slate
npcs.role: Refinery foreman. Hires day labour, docks pay, runs the company store.

npcs.name: Ruby Calder
npcs.role: Refinery engineer. Keeps the column from exploding, mostly by shouting at people.

npcs.name: Hank Dorsey
npcs.role: Derrick rigger. Fearless, loud, and the source of at least half the tall tales in Lanternside.

npcs.name: Pip Wexley
npcs.role: Apprentice and runner at Ober's Oil. Believes every word Sir Moneybucks says.

npcs.name: Delphine Moreau
npcs.role: Refinery chemist. Cold, brilliant, and far more interested in the mystery than the money.

npcs.name: Silas Grimmer
npcs.role: Head of security at Ober's Oil. Watches the gate; breaks strikes when told.

npcs.name: Mabel Quince
npcs.role: Cook at Moneybucks Manor. Champion baker, champion grudge-holder — chiefly against Mags Pell.

npcs.name: Otto Brandt
npcs.role: Pipe fitter at Ober's Oil, quietly organising the workers. Wears a blue thread on his cuff.

npcs.name: Mason Nails
npcs.role: Owner of Mason's Os construction ("That's O plural!"). Cheerful, endlessly punning, and the man you hire to build your future.

npcs.name: Dolores "Dee" Rivera
npcs.role: Site foreman at Mason's Os. Hires day labour, pays fairly, checks every course with a level.

npcs.name: Barnaby Cole
npcs.role: Labourer at Mason's Os. A gentle giant who mixes the cement, lays the bricks and defends every gull in Lanternside.

npcs.name: Quinn Abernathy
npcs.role: Apprentice surveyor and draftsperson at Mason's Os. Nervous, meticulous — and the one who will draw your future house.

npcs.name: Officer Bailey Bond
npcs.role: Beat officer. Smooth, friendly, with a bail-bond business on the side. Walks Lanternside.

npcs.name: Officer Miranda Wright
npcs.role: Rookie. Earnest, nervous, recites people's rights at every opportunity. Walks Westbrook and Gullwing Park.

npcs.name: Marty Fender
npcs.role: Owner, salesman and sole employee of Fender's Pre-Loved Motors, Westbrook Row. Sells three tired cars and buys anything with wheels, no questions asked.
